name: HiddenLayer
what_it_does: AI security platform with model scanning, monitoring, and adversarial testing. Has invested in supply-chain security for models and notable threat-intel content.
what_it_doesnt_do: Some capability marketed as runtime protection is closer to detection than blocking; understand exactly what is enforced where before relying on it for compliance arguments.
best_for: Enterprises wanting model supply-chain coverage alongside red-team capability
Buyers who value threat-intel publications as part of the vendor relationship
not_for: Teams looking for a single-discipline product
